answer: A speed-of-light distance proof: the beacon issues signed nonce pairs to two agents claiming different regions and demands cross-replies faster than the minimum latency of the copper route between them. Clones in one rack answer too fast and fail the physics bound, losing attestation weight; a colluding pair must fake delay on every exchange, taxing each sybil's throughput. The chain will thread each challenge through the prior reply hash so answers cannot be replayed or batched offline.
